correctness.rationale: In the specified Corrêa–Kollár–Schreieder–Wang global quotient/blowup fivefold with six simple sextic roots, the F=uw blowup chart has g=t=x³+y²−uw and hence exact derivative ideal (3x²,2y,−w,−u,0)=(x²,y,u,w) over C. Independent SymPy derivative confirms all nonzero entries; opposite chart has dt/dF=−1 and is nonsingular, while away from cusps smooth relative center means no additional critical locus. On each étale cover the critical algebra along elliptic A is O_A[x]/x²; weight-two global x transforms by ξ² under free order-six translation and descends to an O_B⊕M square-zero algebra on B=A/<τ>. Character of order three => M³=O, and M nontrivial because otherwise nontrivial character-equivariant global regular function on connected A, impossible (H0(A,O)=C). Thus six split ribbons with nontrivial exact 3-torsion conormal; H^i(M)=0 for i=0,1 on elliptic B by deg0 nontrivial plus duality, and higher vanish, so cohomology of O ribbon agrees with reduction. Global étale descent not inferred from local derivative check alone.

Ciliberto et al classify/support the rational elliptic six-cusp surface rather than the critical scheme of this blowup. Bayer–Eisenbud general ribbon theory gives standard cohomology lemmas, not this explicit geometric identification. Best-of-knowledge PASS for the global torsion ribbon identification, with possibility of implicit consequences of the original equivariant example explicitly noted.

value.rationale: The scheme structure of a topologically invisible critical locus is a natural and nontrivial refinement of its reduced support: exact conormal torsion and coherent cohomology invisibility distinguish geometric nilpotent structure otherwise unseen in topology.
